selection_method: Purposive risk-based: 8/46 unique claims; 4/24 MAT and 4/22 ANC. Includes three ordinary/descriptive claims. Not a prevalence estimate.

claims.MAT-K01: Ordinary descriptive chronology; dating versus invention and farming prerequisite.
claims.MAT-K12: High-confidence mechanism; replica experiment versus ancient operation.
claims.MAT-K19: Transmission hypothesis with abstract-only source; selective transformation versus proven route.
claims.ANC-K05: Consequential contested seasonal-operation to market inference; seek rival scholarship.
claims.ANC-K08: Ordinary descriptive counts and legal status from ancient author.
claims.ANC-K14: Ordinary descriptive ancient rights grant; translation versus tax-exemption interpretation.
claims.ANC-K15: High-confidence physical necessity; check source and local gallery scope.
